audit_method: Solved answer and solution independently for every Group A item.
For every item with a circuit or measurement diagram, inspected the actual stored figure/PDF render and determined nodes/branches from the image rather than OCR text.
For multiple-choice items with no unique correct source option, re-opened the source PDF image before making a minimal single-option repair.
True/False items were checked statement by statement.
Learner-facing source-comparison/provenance notes were removed; source corrections are recorded only in this internal report.

topology_spot_checks.result: R1 is in series with the parallel branch containing the lamp and R2; T/F solution expanded from the actual topology.
Upper branch contains R1 then lamp D1; lower branch contains lamp D2; branches are parallel.
Ladder topology verified from figure; no OCR-inferred wire connections used.
R1, R2 and R3 are three parallel branches across the same terminals.
Three external resistor branches are in parallel; ammeter is in the R1 branch.
R3 is parallel with the series pair R1+R2.
Two source polarities were visually checked; both emfs drive the same loop direction, so they add.

fixed.issue: Solution had raw un-delimited equation text and decimal punctuation inconsistency.
